methods.description: Identify and count the named quantities, then write their ratio in the requested order, including reversed order or three groups.
Find the whole by adding the groups or find the other group by subtracting a named part, then write the requested part-to-whole or part-to-other ratio.
Explain the comparison between ratio parts; distinguish it from an unspecified total amount.
